about: Friday the 13th: The Game provides players with the tools to survive, escape, or even attempt to kill an unkillable man. Each gameplay session offers a fresh opportunity to prove whether you have what it takes—not just to survive, but to outmatch the greatest killer in cinematic history!

Meanwhile, Jason is equipped with a variety of abilities to track, hunt, and eliminate his prey. Emerge from the shadows, terrify your targets, and dispatch them in the most brutal ways imaginable. Take control of the legendary killer, Jason Voorhees, and strike fear into the hearts of those unfortunate enough to cross your path!
summary: Friday the 13th: The Game provides players with the tools to survive, escape, or even attempt to kill an unkillable man.
